title: France: packaging EPR registration and Triman marking
summary: A producer placing packaged household goods on the French market must hold a unique identifier, contribute to an approved eco-organisme, and apply the Triman sorting marking with its Info-tri instructions.

sources.title: Code de l'environnement — Art. L541-10, L541-10-1, L541-9-3 (Légifrance)
sources.note: Direct fetch of legifrance.gouv.fr was blocked by its bot-check page; text below is quoted verbatim from Légifrance's own page via search, not from memory, but could not be re-fetched to double check today — re-verify with a browser before relying on this for the live catalog. FINDING: this requirement's original single citation, Art. L541-10, is the *general* extended-producer-responsibility principle that applies to all REP categories, not packaging specifically. The article that actually brings household packaging under REP is L541-10-1 ('Relèvent du principe de responsabilité élargie du producteur... 1° Les emballages servant à commercialiser les produits consommés ou utilisés par les ménages...'). The Triman-marking duty bundled into this same requirement row is a *separate* article, L541-9-3, not L541-10 at all ('Tout produit mis sur le marché à destination des ménages soumis au I de l'article L. 541-10... fait l'objet d'une signalétique...'). Tabeen decision needed: correct the citation to L541-10-1 + L541-9-3 (done above), or split this into two requirement rows (EPR registration vs. Triman marking) the way the schema's two required_evidence entries already suggest it could be.
